name: Jiangsu Xukuang Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Xukuang Energy Co., Ltd. engages in the mining, washing, processing, and wholesale of coal. It is also involved in new energy development; thermal power generation; coal sales; road freight transport; power generation, transmission, and supply business; photovoltaic power generation; sale of electricity; and development and operation of energy engineering, and international investment and international projects. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Xuzhou, China. Jiangsu Xukuang Energy Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Xuzhou Mining Group Co., Ltd.
